source_row.rationale: Structured role assignment during a code blue response (such as through team roles defined in ACLS protocols) helps ensure organized, efficient, coordinated care during a high-stress, time-critical event, reducing duplication of effort, communication gaps, and missed essential tasks — an evidence-based approach shown to improve resuscitation team performance and patient outcomes.
source_row.source_detail: Importance of Structured Roles During Code Response
source_row.source_name: American Heart Association — ACLS Team Dynamics and Role Assignment
source_row.stem: During a "code blue" cardiac/respiratory arrest response, team members are assigned specific roles, such as chest compressions, airway management, medication administration, and documentation, though a new team member assumes a more free-flowing, unstructured approach would actually work better in the chaos of the moment.
